item.title: azure: Announcing: Aspire 13.5 has shipped
item.description:
Aspire 13.5 has shipped. This release refreshes the dashboard and aspire.dev, expands the Interaction Service, adds cross-scope Azure references and persistent Kubernetes volumes, and introduces live terminals in the apphost.

  • Source: Azure Updates
